title: i3blocks: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR falls back to /run/user/$UID
objective: The gaming, shutdown and screen-locker blocks read daily-limits' cache from /run/user/$UID when the X session has no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, instead of looking in /tmp and showing '⏱? no data'.
acceptance_criteria: With XDG_RUNTIME_DIR unset, gaming_budget.sh and shutdown_countdown.sh render the live cache (time left, unearned earners)
No i3blocks script falls back to /tmp for XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (checked in test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh)
out_of_scope: Reconnecting systemd-logind to the system bus (needs a logind restart and relogin)
Finding what re-parses systemd units every ~6 s
